notablePrerequisites: Audacious Reshapers does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Audacious Reshapers by tapping it and sacrificing Tocasia's Onulet.
When Tocasia's Onulet dies, it and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Tocasia's Onulet trigger, causing you to gain 2 life.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tocasia's Onulet on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Audacious Reshapers ability, revealing Tocasia's Onulet from the top of your library, then putting it onto the battlefield and dealing 1 damage to you.
When Tocasia's Onulet enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
